## Independent re-derivation: kic-006515744 (first-screen signal, not a planet)

**Method.** Own loader + running-median detrend (1 d window, per quarter, positive-only 4-sigma clip), own BLS grid, astropy `BoxLeastSquares`. No code under `pipeline/` was imported or read; `vet.json` was opened only after my numbers were written. Script, JSON and figure are in `/home/user/ZyushgPlanet/runs/poolA_main/adversarial/kic-006515744/rederive/`. Data: `LIGHTCURVE_STITCHED`, `SAP_QUALITY == 0`, 24,871 cadences (24,690 after positive clip), quarters 0,1,2,3,6,10,11,14, baseline 1250.8 d.

**1. Blind BLS 1-50 d.** Top three peaks (raw log-likelihood): 33.4216 d (power 166.0), 49.718 d (156.7), 43.326 d (156.3, ~6/5 x 36.2075). Median-flattened ranking: 33.4216, 43.326, 30.782 d. Depth-SNR ranking: 33.4216, 49.718, 43.326 d. **36.2075 d is not recovered as the top peak** and only the 43.3 d third peak is a loose alias. SDE (BLS log-likelihood, PSF flux, all quarters) = 8.2 raw / 16.7 flattened; inverted null (2-f) = 7.2 / 7.8.

**2. Best ephemeris (own refinement).** P = 33.42181 d, t0 = BKJD 133.4822 (BJD 2454966.4822), best duration = 0.02 d = 0.48 h (shortest trial value; depth drops monotonically with longer boxes, so the feature is narrower than one 29.4-min cadence). Box depth 13028 +/- 513 ppm (empirical MAD error from 3000 random-phase boxes, 13 in-box cadences; no random box deeper). Odd 11822 +/- 698, even 13877 +/- 722 ppm, odd/even 2.0 sigma. Secondary at phase 0.5: -447 +/- 516 ppm (-0.9 sigma; 80 percent of random boxes deeper). Deepest other-phase box 1861 ppm (3.6 sigma).

**3. What the depth is made of.** 38 epochs fall in the baseline, 13 have any cadence inside the 0.48 h window, **none has two**. Per-event depths: BKJD 200.33 (Q2) 65192 +/- 3621 ppm and BKJD 1370.09 (Q14) 35273 +/- 1317 ppm; the other 11 are -18391 to +5784 ppm, all consistent with zero at < 2 sigma. Single-event dominance 0.56. Per-year: 2009 28741, 2010 1065, 2011 858, 2012 18812 ppm (+/- ~1000 ppm each). A periodic 1.3 percent transit does not go missing for two years in quarters with in-window data. The 200.33 cadence is also epoch 2.000 of the pipeline ephemeris, so both periods are built on the same single point.

**4. SAP vs PSF (dilution).** SAP_FLUX box depth 1545 +/- 146 ppm vs PSF 13028 ppm, ratio 0.12. With crowdsap 0.77 and psffrac 0.88 a real dip on this source should survive in SAP at roughly 0.7-0.9 of the PSF depth. Worse, the ratio is not even consistent event to event: 0.42 at BKJD 200.33 but 0.00 at BKJD 1370.09 (SAP shows nothing). That pattern points to PSF-fit systematics on individual cadences, not an astrophysical dimming of the background star.

**5. Comparison with pipeline vet.json** (P 36.2075 d, depth 12763 ppm, 1.1 h, snr_emp 13.8, stage2_pass true under v1.5, failed v1.4 on tls_sde 5.4). The headline depth agrees numerically but for the wrong reason: both measurements average a handful of single-cadence outliers. The pipeline's own per-event table (`events.csv`) has one usable event at 357 +/- 585 ppm with event_dof 0, which is already a warning that the stage-2 event-consistency test had nothing to test. No pixel-level run exists (`runs/poolA_main/pixel/kic-006515744/` absent).

**Verdict for the adversarial pack.** I do not reproduce the pipeline period blind, I cannot find a duration longer than one cadence, two of thirteen events carry the signal, the depth disappears in 2010-2011, and it is absent from SAP flux at the second dominant event. On this re-derivation kic-006515744 should be classified as a single-cadence-outlier / PSF-systematic first-screen signal, not advanced to pixel vetting unless the two cadences at BKJD 200.33 and 1370.09 are first shown to be clean in the per-quarter extensions and the TPF.
